summary: The future of the V8 pickup engine in 2026-2027: why Ram dropped the Hemi and brought it back in six months, GM's new 5.7L and 6.6L Small Block V8s and the L87 recall, Ford's F-150 V8 reversal, the end of CAFE fines and the electric-truck slowdown, and why Toyota is the one automaker not bringing its V8 back. Every number comes from a published source, listed below.
